verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a cloud email service like Outlook, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers choosing a storage region or data residency. The Graph mail API docs and community threads address mail operations, link handling, performance and ads, none of which bear on where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
